description: Search federal PACER dockets by party — live party-name search across federal PACER (Appellate, Bankruptcy, Civil, Criminal, MDL). Note: this passes live PACER search fees at cost. Returns matching federal cases with court, docket, title, and filing date. Example: docketalarm_search_pacer({ party_name: "Microsoft Corporation", _apiKey: "user@example.com:yourpassword" })

_apiKey.description: Docket Alarm credentials as "username:password" from your docketalarm.com account.

court_region.description: Optional regional filter to narrow the PACER search.

party_name.description: Company or individual party name to search for on PACER.

name: docketalarm_search_pacer
title: Docketalarm Search Pacer
